_doc.about: self-improve settings. The plugin creates this file on first run; plugin updates never change it. Every value here is null, which means "use the built-in default" (shown in each note), so this file behaves like having none and follows the defaults of later versions. Replace a null to change that setting. An environment variable SELF_IMPROVE_<NAME> wins over this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_doc.output_dir: Where review-*.md, needs-context-*.md and change-log.md go. Empty = ~/.claude/self-improve/reviews
_doc.wiki_dir: A markdown wiki (INDEX.md + log.md + pages) to lint and audit. Empty = wiki features off
_doc.raw_dir: Source files the wiki is built from. Never edited. Empty = off
_doc.wiki_auto_dirs: Wiki sub-folders with generated pages, skipped by the lint and the wiki analyst. Default: none
_doc.skill_roots: Extra skill folders. ~/.claude/skills is always included. Default: none
_doc.project_roots: Folders whose */CLAUDE.md and */*/CLAUDE.md count as edit targets. Default: none
_doc.extra_protected: More files or folders the guard protects during a run. Default: none
_doc.allow_inline_code: 1 = during a run, let python3 -c, node -e and heredocs into interpreters run unless their text names a protected path. 0 = blocked. Default: 0
_doc.launch_command: Opens a separate session; {name} and {prompt} are replaced. Empty = no launch
_doc.notify_command: Program called with one line of text at the end of a step. Empty = no notifications
_doc.wait_for_lock: If this file exists, start exits with code 3 (another job is writing). Empty = off
_doc.ignore_message_regex: User messages matching this are not read (e.g. text a hook injects). Empty = read all
_doc.max_signoff: Most SIGN-OFF items per run. Default: 10
_doc.lock_wait_minutes: wait-lock gives up after this many minutes (exit 3). Default: 180
_doc.pre_run_command: Runs at start before anything is read; its output goes into changes.md. Exit 3 = busy, wait. Empty = none
_doc.extra_lint_command: Runs during the lint; each output line is one more finding. Empty = none
_doc.language: Language for item titles, questions and the chat summary, e.g. Portuguese. Empty = off
_doc.analyst_notes: Your own instructions for the analysts and the plan: text, or the path of a file. Empty = none
_doc.claude_command: The claude program human-review asks for open sessions. Empty = claude on PATH
_doc.labels: Your words for the fixed text render writes into review-*.md and needs-context-*.md, as {key: text}. Missing keys stay English, unknown keys are ignored with a warning. In review_intro and context_intro, {run}, {note} and {answer} are replaced. Keys and English defaults: review_title = 'improve-system review'; review_intro = 'Run `{run}`. Mark `[x]` to apply, `[-]` to reject for good. Leave `[ ]` to decide later (it comes back in the next run). To adjust an item, write a line `{note}: ...` right below it.'; review_footer = 'Nothing here is applied before the next run (or execute-reviewed).'; new = 'New'; still_pending = 'Still pending'; where = 'Where'; evidence = 'Evidence'; change = 'Change'; why = 'Why'; risk = 'Risk'; exact_change = 'Exact change'; replace = 'replace'; with = 'with'; pending_since = 'Pending since'; note = 'Note'; context_title = 'Context needed'; context_intro = 'Run `{run}`. Answer on the **{answer}:** line of each question. The next run reads the answers and picks the bucket.'; why_i_ask = 'Why I ask'; answer = 'Answer'. Empty = English
